conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion filter by assessing the deviation of the current close from the 50-period rolling mean, normalized as a z-score to isolate extreme price displacements suitable for statistical arbitrage.
rationale: Statistical arbitrage relies on detecting temporary dislocations from a long-term average. By using a z-score of the price relative to its rolling mean, we can quantify the 'stretched' state of an asset, identifying conditions where mean reversion is statistically more probable.
